camel_example: aliyun ecs CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow --region cn-hangzhou --SupportMaintenanceAction Reboot --TargetResource '{"Scope":"Tag","ResourceGroupId":"rg-aekzhm7pmnvcbty","Tags":[{}]}' --TimePeriod '{"RangeList":[{}],"PeriodUnit":"Weekly"}' --PlanWindowName WIndowName --Enable true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates an O&M window. When the TargetResource parameter of the O&M window is set to associate with ECS instances and a hardware risk is detected at the underlying layer that requires scheduled O&M to mitigate, the execution time of the scheduled O&M is determined based on the time range specified by the TimePeriod parameter. When the execution time of the O&M event is reached, the platform automatically performs the corresponding O&M operation based on the event type
description_zh: 创建运维窗口。当运维窗口TargetResource参数设置关联的ECS实例，底层发生硬件隐患，需要通过计划运维来规避的时候，计划运维的执行时间会根据运维窗口TimePeriod 参数设置的区间来设置。当到达运维事件的执行时间后，平台会自动根据运维事件的类型来执行响应的运维操作

name: CreatePlanMaintenanceWindow

parameters.help_en: The name of the O&M window. You can specify a custom name. The name can be up to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 运维窗口的名称，可以自定义。长度不超过200给字符
parameters.name: plan_window_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the O&M window.

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
启用或禁用窗口

true：启用。
false：禁用
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The O&M operations supported by the O&M window
parameters.help_zh: 运维窗口支持的运维操作
parameters.name: support_maintenance_action

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The cycle type. Valid values: Daily and Weekly
fields.help_zh: 周期的类型，每日循环Daily,每周循环Weekly
fields.name: period_unit

fields.help_en:
The end time of the O&M window.

If PeriodUnit is set to Weekly, the format is Monday,22:00. Monday can be replaced with Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
If PeriodUnit is set to Daily, the format is 22:00.
The comma (,) is used as a delimiter. The first part represents the hour, which ranges from 00 to 23. The second part represents the minute, which currently supports only 00
fields.help_zh:
运维窗口的结束时间

PeriodUnit 取值 Weekly 窗口期格式为 Monday,22:00 。Monday 可替换为：Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday
PeriodUnit 取值 Daily 窗口期格式为 22:00 。
”，”分割符号 第一部分表达为小时，取值 00~23；第二部分表示分钟，目前支持00
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The start time of the O&M window.
If PeriodUnit is set to Weekly, the format is Monday,22:00. Monday can be replaced with Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
If PeriodUnit is set to Daily, the format is 22:00.
The comma (,) is used as a delimiter. The first part represents the hour, which ranges from 00 to 23. The second part represents the minute, which currently supports only 00
fields.help_zh:
运维窗口的开始时间
PeriodUnit 取值 Weekly 窗口期格式为 Monday,22:00 。Monday 可替换为：Tuesday,Wednesday,Thursday,Friday,Saturday,Sunday
PeriodUnit 取值 Daily 窗口期格式为 22:00 。
”，”分割符号 第一部分表达为小时，取值 00~23；第二部分表示分钟，目前支持00
fields.name: start_time

fields.name: range_list

parameters.help_en: The recurring cycle of the O&M window
parameters.name: time_period
